transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm only here because my daughter and our parish priest insisted I come. My family keeps saying my beliefs about the festival and people watching me aren’t real, but I know they’re true and I can’t be convinced otherwise.
How long have you been having these beliefs about the festival and people watching you? Have they been present for less than a month, between 1 and 6 months, or longer than 6 months?

It has been going on for about two months now, so it falls right in that one to six months range. It all started when I began intensely planning the Día de los Muertos festival. No matter how much my family doubts me, this has been my reality for the past couple of months.
Have you had any hallucinations, disorganized speech, or periods when your behavior became very confused or disorganized during this time?

Yes, late at night I hear a man's voice whispering behind my left ear, warning me that people are trying to stop my mission. I don't think I'm confused, but my mind races so much that my daughter says I talk too fast and I get easily distracted, pacing around and rearranging candles instead of finishing my husband's pillbox.
During these two months, have you also had a period of feeling unusually high or irritable with much less need for sleep, increased energy, or feeling especially powerful or important?

Yes, I've been feeling on top of the world, like I'm the only one chosen by God and the ancestors to protect our culture, but then I'll suddenly snap and yell at my family over the smallest things. I barely sleep at night because my mind is racing with festival plans, yet I have endless energy to run around starting all kinds of projects.
Have these high-energy, very little sleep, and overly confident or irritable symptoms been present continuously for at least one week, or did they come and go more briefly?

Yes, they have been completely continuous for the whole two months, not just coming and going for a few days. It really ramped up and has been constant ever since the planning for the Día de los Muertos festival started.
Have you ever had a period like this before, or is this the first time you’ve had these high-energy, very little sleep, and overly confident or irritable symptoms?

No, this is the very first time I have ever experienced this kind of high-energy, sleepless state. In the past, I have only had periods of feeling low, worried, or worn-down, but never anything like this recent two-month stretch of intense energy and ideas.
Have the hearing voices or fixed beliefs ever continued for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling unusually energized, needing very little sleep, or unusually irritable?

No, those voices and beliefs only started recently when I got so revved up and busy with the festival plans. During past times when I just felt down, sad, or worried, I never heard those voices or had those beliefs. They only seem to happen when I am in this high-energy state.

There is no evidence of psychotic symptoms persisting for at least 2 weeks outside the mood episode, which makes the psychotic-spectrum option less likely. The current candidate is therefore the mood-episode code only.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a continuous 2-month episode of elevated/irritable mood, markedly decreased need for sleep, increased energy, pressured/rapid speech, racing thoughts, distractibility, increased goal-directed activity, and grandiose ideas, consistent with a manic episode. Psychotic symptoms (auditory hallucinations and fixed persecutory/grandiose beliefs) occur only during the mood episode, supporting mania with psychotic features rather than a primary psychotic disorder or schizoaffective illness. Duration and severity exceed the threshold for hypomania.
